title: Handyman Business Forms Bundle, Independent Contractor Agreement, Job Estimate, Work Order, Change Order, Invoice, Fillable PDF and Word
description:
Tired of quoting on scraps of paper and chasing payments for extra work? This kit gives your handyman or contracting business the 8 documents you need, from the first call to the signed completion and invoice.

WHO IT'S FOR
Handymen, general contractors, remodelers, painters, plumbers, electricians, landscapers and any home service pro.

WHAT YOU GET
8 documents, each as a fillable PDF and an editable Word file, in US Letter and A4 (2 ZIP files), plus a 2-page START HERE guide:
1. Independent Contractor Agreement - parties, project, price, deposit, 9 terms (scope, independent status, materials, payment, site access, delays, warranty, insurance and permits, cancellation), signatures
2. Job Estimate - labor and materials lines, totals, deposit, duration
3. Work Order - job type, assigned crew, time and materials, work performed
4. Change Order - change description, cost and schedule impact, approval
5. Material List - 20 lines with specs, quantities, costs, bought check
6. Job Completion & Sign-Off - walkthrough checklist, punch list, final balance, client confirmation
7. Invoice - 12 lines, deposit, total due, payment terms
8. Client Intake & Job Request - contact, job details, budget, timing, site visit

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- Fillable PDF: type in the fields, save, print or email to clients
- Word version: add your logo, license number, rates and your own terms
- Change Order and Sign-Off help you get paid for every extra and close jobs cleanly
- Clean, professional look that helps you win jobs

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the ZIP for your paper size (US Letter or A4)
2. Open the Word files to add your logo, business details and rates
3. Use the fillable PDFs with free Adobe Acrobat Reader, or print them
4. Keep a signed copy of each document in the job file

GOOD TO KNOW
- Digital download, nothing is shipped
- Fillable PDFs: free Adobe Acrobat Reader recommended
- Word files open in Microsoft Word, Google Docs or Pages
- General templates, not legal advice; contractor and licensing rules differ by state or country, have your agreement reviewed locally
- For use in your own business, no resale
- Due to the digital nature of this product, returns are not accepted. Message me with any question!
